items.html: However, during the three days of absorption, all four Kelim were bound together through the drop of the union, as mentioned above. And in the first three months, the vessel of the brain of Chochma was corrected, which is the primary one of all of them. Therefore, at that point the fetus becomes recognizable, as our sages said. And the rest of the Kelim of the Mochin were completed in twelve months, and regarding the phase of the sparks, which are the membranes mentioned above, they are only three Mochin, in the phase of the membranes, which are three.
